policy: Full raw fields retained locally outside Git; this tracked manifest identifies immutable root archive paths. Raw timing/error JSON, source, proofs, audits, and checkpoints are tracked separately.
extraction: Verify SHA256, create an empty destination, then tar -xf ARCHIVE -C DESTINATION. Consult member_prefixes before choosing a destination; never overwrite an existing run.

burgers2d-validation-initial.tar.role: Saved validation inputs for initial-fit diagnosis
burgers2d-validation-initial.tar.retention: hard link under main; worktree cleanup may unlink only the worktree name

burgers2d-diagnose01.tar.role: Validation-only multistart fits and exact CP affine-span diagnostic
burgers2d-diagnose01.tar.retention: hard link under main; worktree cleanup may unlink only the worktree name

burgers2d-validation01.tar.role: Complete immutable validation cohort, paired timing proxies, full fields, checkpoints, quadrature and selection proofs
burgers2d-validation01.tar.retention: hard link under main; worktree cleanup may unlink only the worktree name
